title: Origins of the Universe & Human Life

flashcard_questions.q: Periods of time mentioned in the Qur’an during which Allah created the heavens and the earth; not necessarily literal 24-hour days.
Ways of understanding religious texts, ranging from literal (word-for-word) to metaphorical (symbolic meaning).
The scientific theory that the universe began approximately 13.8 billion years ago from an extremely hot, dense point that rapidly expanded.

flashcard_questions.a: The belief that humans are created in God’s likeness, giving them a unique status and dignity in creation.
The role given to humans by God to look after and care for the earth and its creatures on God’s behalf.
